rationale: User after 041: selected palette row background is almost impossible to distinguish from the foreground. GPUI used theme.accent @ 0.22; on this theme accent ≈ foreground so the highlight vanished. wezterm-gui inverts command_palette_fg_color / command_palette_bg_color (defaults gray 0.75 on #333333). Honor those lua keys; selected row is a solid invert, not accent opacity. Do not start 026/031. Do not honor command_palette_font unless asked.
